schema drift hidden by casts: the hand-written Run/RunEvent/Schedule/Approval/Checkpoint interfaces use created_at/updated_at, but the drizzle schema (cowork.sql.ts via Timestamps) stores time_created/time_updated — the `as Run[]` etc. casts return rows whose created_at is undefined at runtime, which the API routes (routes/cowork.ts zod created_at: z.number()) and CLI (new Date(run.created_at)) would choke on; also the schema's mode $type ("local"|"remote"|"cloud") omits "vm" that RunService accepts and RunMode declares. Fixing needs a runtime mapping/behavior change, outside type-only scope.
